snippet.title: Ruindrift - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You can wishlist on steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556050/Ruindrift/

Ruindrift is a fast-paced, tight, real-time battler with no movement. Choose a class, pick 12 abilities, and lock in against challenging enemies using stuns, interrupts, defenses, and dodges as you traverse sprawling worlds in ruin.
